subject.title: [Feature]: Load macOS onboarding providers from Gateway catalog

question: Should macOS Connect your AI manual API-key setup become a catalog-backed provider-auth flow through `crestodian.setup.detect` and `crestodian.setup.activate`, or should non-core providers remain outside guided app onboarding for now?
rationale: This changes first-run macOS onboarding, Gateway protocol shape, and provider-auth ownership boundaries, and the live issue has the protected `maintainer` label plus an explicit product-decision marker.

options.title: Implement catalog-backed macOS setup
options.body: Extend the Gateway setup RPCs additively and render provider-owned text-inference API-key choices in the macOS app.

options.title: Keep the three-provider picker
options.body: Leave macOS onboarding limited to Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google while other providers use CLI or plugin setup paths.

options.title: Split protocol design first
options.body: Keep this issue open for product direction and create a narrower protocol/API design item before implementation.

recommendation.title: Implement catalog-backed macOS setup
recommendation.body: Extend the Gateway setup RPCs additively and render provider-owned text-inference API-key choices in the macOS app.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current verified onboarding flow and opened this catalog-backed replacement request.
